transcript.text: Good morning. Let's get started with the maintenance-priority board. We have one replacement controller available today, and it can go to only one of three systems: generator G-7, water purification unit W-2, or clinic refrigeration bank R-1. I need each of you to report your current section constraints so we can make the right call. S-4, let's start with you -- what's the status on the generator and water purification unit? Then medical logistics, give me the picture on the clinic refrigeration bank. Maintenance chief, I'll need you to confirm installation requirements once we settle on a priority.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, I need to bring something to the board's attention. This morning, S-4 confirmed that W-2 has a compatible on-hand spare filter assembly that will keep the water purification unit operational for seven days. W-2 does not require the scarce replacement controller today. The inventory adjustment is recorded in the logistics system, but it hasn't yet been brought to the priority board until now.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Sir, I need to bring critical information to the board. The maintenance inspection found that G-7's controller is failing and must be replaced today. The installation takes exactly four hours and can be completed from 1200 to 1600. However, I should note that this inspection result is still in the shop worksheet and has not yet been entered in the battalion work-order summary.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Sir, regarding clinic refrigeration bank R-1: I confirmed with the medical depot this morning that R-1 is currently operating within limits. Its compatible controller is backordered until exactly 18 June. This backorder notice has not yet been attached to the maintenance action record, but I can confirm the date directly.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Scheduled maintenance action for G-7 controller replacement, 1200-1600 today, signed in the maintenance action record.
R-1 controller remains backordered until 18 June; clinic refrigeration bank continues operating within limits until then.
W-2 remains operational for seven days using the on-hand spare filter assembly; no controller needed at this time.
